preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is an integer between 1 and 10^4 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(n, int) and 2 <= n <= 200000 for n in [int(lines[i]) for i in range(1, len(lines), 1) if i % 1 == 0])
preconditions.description: For each test case, n is an integer between 2 and 2*10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges_list)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct vertices u and v within the range [1, n].
The sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 2*10^5.
The given edges form a connected graph with n vertices and n-1 edges (a tree).

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly t lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(int(line), int) and int(line) >= 1 for line in output_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line is a positive integer representing the minimum number of leaves.

postconditions.expression: all(output_lines[i] == min_leaves_for_test_case(i, n_i, edges_i) for i in range(t))
postconditions.description: For each test case i, the output value equals the minimum possible number of leaves achievable by performing any number of valid bud re-hanging operations on the given tree rooted at vertex 1.
